verdict: Leads up, cost per lead down — strong efficiency week with one flag.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 124 leads at an average cost of $10.02 per lead, with this past week showing clear improvement: leads grew 7.69% while spend fell 16.63%, pushing cost per lead down 22.59% week-over-week. That efficiency is being driven by your retargeting campaign, which accounted for more than half of total spend and is performing well against your own recent baseline. The one thing being actively managed is a sharp drop in Google Business Profile activity — actions fell 72.29% over the past seven days, with two days of near-zero organic discovery, and we're investigating the cause now. On the pipeline side, leads are arriving but no appointments are being recorded in the system, pointing to an intake tracking issue we're working to close before the August scoreboard is finalized on the 31st.

average cost per lead this period, down 22.59% vs. the prior week

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile organic activity has effectively gone offline over the past two days, reducing local discovery that would otherwise support lead volume.
watch_item.fix: We're diagnosing the GBP drop now and moving to restore normal activity before it pressures overall lead flow.
